verdict.rationale: Devin's own API lets you create agent sessions programmatically and 'automate workflows', so a CI job or shell script could kick off a cloud Devin session. However, Devin for Terminal is documented only for interactive use, with nothing showing a non-interactive or headless mode that runs inside a pipeline. Auto-Fix iterating on CI failures responds to CI results rather than running inside CI, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: a documented headless or non-interactive CLI mode, CI/CD integration docs or examples (e.g. a GitHub Actions setup), exit codes and output handling for scripts, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run an agent headlessly inside CI/CD pipelines and shell scripts

citations.quote: The Devin API enables you to integrate Devin into your applications, automate workflows, and build powerful tools.
